systems.name: QuickBooks Online (assumed — P0 unconfirmed)

systems.rateLimits: 500 req/min per app per realm (company); batch API limited to 30 operations per call
knownQuirks: CRITICAL P0: QBO vs Desktop/Enterprise not confirmed — two entirely different integration architectures
OAuth 2.0 refresh token expires after 100 days of non-use — automated token refresh must be built into MuleSoft config or rotation will break production sync
Webhook events use Intuit verification header (intuit-signature) — must verify HMAC-SHA256 signature before processing
QB customer record must exist before invoice creation — Salesforce Account must map to an existing QB Customer by name or QB CustomerId; no QB customer auto-creation in UC1 scope
QB fiscal year starts April 1 (confirmed in transcript) — date-range filters for inventory and invoice queries must use April 1 offset
QB Company ID (realmId) required on every API call — must be stored in properties, not hardcoded
prerequisites: CONFIRM QBO vs Desktop/Enterprise — entire connector path changes
If QBO: register Connected App at developer.intuit.com; obtain Client ID + Secret (Maria or Crystal to authorize)
If QBO: provision sandbox company for integration testing before touching production

systems.name: QuickBooks Desktop/Enterprise (alternative path if P0 resolves Desktop)
systems.authDetail: QBXML Web Connector running on Windows machine hosting QB Desktop — no REST API; CloudHub 2.0 cannot reach local QBXML relay directly
systems.rateLimits: N/A — QBXML is synchronous, serial processing only
knownQuirks: NO native MuleSoft connector for QB Desktop/Enterprise
QBXML Web Connector is Windows-only and must run on the same machine as QB — cannot be reached from CloudHub 2.0 directly
Integration options if Desktop: (a) CData JDBC Driver — REST wrapper over QBXML; (b) Conductor REST — cloud relay for QB Desktop API; (c) Upgrade client to QB Online
Any Desktop bridge solution adds cost ($1,500–$5,000/yr for CData or Conductor) and operational complexity
DataSkate recommendation: strongly advise QB Online upgrade if client is on Desktop — saves relay complexity and cost at their scale
prerequisites: Confirm QB version first — if Desktop, assess upgrade-to-Online cost vs bridge cost for client
If bridge required: Conductor or CData licensing must be procured before integration build starts
systems.confidence: high (for the finding that this is the alternative architecture)

systems.name: Google Sheets

systems.rateLimits: 300 reads/min per project; 60 writes/min per project — no concern at UC3 polling frequency

Google Sheets connector returns rows as arrays — DataWeave must handle variable row counts and map positional columns to named fields

Holly confirms spreadsheet column headers are stable and provides a sample export

confirmedFlows.name: Salesforce Agreement → QuickBooks Invoice Creation
confirmedFlows.triggerDetail: Salesforce Platform Event or CDC on Agreement object (Closed Won / Agreement Created); Mule subscribes as consumer
confirmedFlows.evidence: when an agreement is created in Salesforce, it will generate a new invoice in QuickBooks for an existing account
confirmedFlows.architectNotes: ISBN lookup step required in flow before QB invoice creation — query Salesforce ISBN lookup table (state × product → ISBN) before constructing QB line items. Missing ISBN = route to manual review queue, not to DLQ. QB customer must pre-exist by name match or QB_CustomerId__c lookup field on SF Account.

confirmedFlows.name: QuickBooks Invoice Status → Salesforce Agreement Sync
confirmedFlows.triggerDetail: Scheduled poll of QB invoices (delta by LastModifiedDate using QB fiscal year April 1 offset); upsert to Salesforce Agreement using QB_InvoiceId__c external ID
confirmedFlows.evidence: track payment updates from QuickBooks to Salesforce, including the open balance... update the number, amount, dates
confirmedFlows.architectNotes: Watermark required — use QB transaction ModifyTime for incremental delta. Persistent Object Store for watermark. External ID QB_InvoiceId__c on Agreement enables safe upsert without duplication risk.

confirmedFlows.name: Holly's Demand Worksheet → Salesforce Inventory__c
confirmedFlows.triggerDetail: Scheduled poll of Holly's demand worksheet (connector TBD based on storage location P0); upsert into Salesforce Inventory__c custom object by Title/ISBN
confirmedFlows.evidence: push the data directly um and the details directly from Excel in real time or from QuickBooks if it's living in QuickBooks. And so then we can push that inventory data directly into Salesforce
confirmedFlows.architectNotes: Connector key is conditional: google-sheets if Holly uses Google Sheets; microsoft-excel-online if SharePoint/OneDrive. Cannot be finalized until storage P0 is resolved. Fields to map: title, quantity on hand, committed, available, 3% buffer threshold, projected shorts flag.

confirmedFlows.name: QuickBooks Inventory Items → Salesforce Inventory__c (Cost Data)
confirmedFlows.triggerDetail: Scheduled poll of QB Inventory Items (Item type); upsert to Salesforce Inventory__c by QB Item name/ID for cost and quantity fields
confirmedFlows.evidence: some of this lives in QuickBooks... you are going to be able to see like ... algebra 6 books six equals x amount ... value of inventory ... cost per district, cost per program
confirmedFlows.architectNotes: UC3 and UC4 both write to Inventory__c — must agree on field ownership to avoid overwrite conflicts. Proposed: UC3 owns quantity/demand fields; UC4 owns cost/value fields. Upsert key should be a composite of ISBN + title slug. Polling schedule should be coordinated so UC4 runs after UC3.

potentialFlows.rationale: Maria is adding new titles to QB and SF separately. Without sync, the QB Item list and SF Product catalog will diverge — breaking UC1 line item matching and UC4 cost lookup. Deferred pending Maria's input on system of record (QB or SF). This is a dependency risk for UC1 and UC4, not just a nice-to-have.

Holly: sales ships materials ahead of a closed-won agreement on a CCR. When the agreement comes in, the system must know materials were already shipped — otherwise UC1 would create a duplicate fulfillment QB invoice. Flag must stamp the incoming Agreement before UC1 fires.

Each order decrements inventory. If inventory master moves to QB (post UC4), decrement events need to sync to Salesforce Inventory__c so Holly's dashboard stays accurate in near real-time. Currently implicit in UC3/UC4 scheduled sync — but a lag means Salesforce could show incorrect available stock between sync runs.

p0Blockers.title: QuickBooks Version Confirmation
p0Blockers.clientAction:
Please confirm which QuickBooks product your team uses — we need this before any integration work can begin:
  (a) QuickBooks Online — the web-based version you access at app.qbo.intuit.com in a browser.
  (b) QuickBooks Desktop Pro or Premier — installed as a program on a Windows PC.
  (c) QuickBooks Enterprise — the advanced desktop version.

If you're not sure: the easiest check is whether you open QuickBooks in a web browser (Online) or by clicking an icon on your desktop (Desktop/Enterprise). Maria Gonzalez-Pettway or Crystal Robinson should know which version is in use.
p0Blockers.body: QBO path: mule-quickbooks-online-connector 3.0.0 (REST/OAuth 2.0) — clean cloud-to-cloud integration. QB Desktop/Enterprise path: NO native MuleSoft connector; NO REST API. Requires QBXML Web Connector on the Windows machine running QB, then a bridge layer (CData JDBC or Conductor REST relay) to reach CloudHub 2.0 — adds $1,500–$5,000/yr licensing cost and on-prem relay maintenance. DataSkate recommendation if Desktop: assess upgrade to QB Online first. FK-020 verified: never assume QBO.
bundledWith: QB OAuth credentials (Crystal or Maria to authorize)

p0Blockers.title: Inventory Spreadsheet Storage Location
p0Blockers.clientAction:
We need to know where Holly Wale's inventory demand worksheet is stored before we can build the integration. Please confirm one of the following:
  (a) Holly's local laptop — this CANNOT work with our integration platform (cloud-hosted; no access to local files). The file would need to be moved to a shared cloud location before we can begin.
  (b) SharePoint or OneDrive — we can connect to this; please provide the SharePoint site URL and file path.
  (c) Google Drive or Google Sheets — we can connect to this; Chloe (IT) will need to provide a Google Service Account credential so our system can read the file.

Holly Wale (hwale@agilemind.com) or Chloe (IT Director) can confirm this.
p0Blockers.body: CloudHub 2.0 has an ephemeral local filesystem — the File connector cannot read local PC paths. If client insists on local-only and will not migrate: SFTP drop-zone on a cloud server is the only bridge (adds operational overhead and manual step for Holly). If QB version confirms QB Online and inventory lives fully in QB, UC3 may be replaced by UC4 entirely (QB as sole inventory source) — making this P0 conditional on the UC3 design decision.
bundledWith: SharePoint Graph API app registration (if OneDrive path)
Holly column-header documentation for DataWeave mapping

systemFindings.finding: Connector confirmed in registry: mule-salesforce-connector 11.4.0, OAuth JWT. Platform Events and CDC supported on custom objects. Inventory__c object does not yet exist — must be created in scope. Custom Agreement object confirmed with existing QB invoice custom fields.

State/Country Picklists: if enabled, mailing state values on Opportunity/Agreement are ISO codes (US-CA not California). DataWeave ISBN lookup table keys must match the exact stored format. Must be confirmed before UC1 DWL is written.

IF QBO confirmed: mule-quickbooks-online-connector 3.0.0, Intuit REST API v3, OAuth 2.0. Sandbox company available at developer.intuit.com. OAuth refresh token expires after 100 days non-use — automated rotation needed in MuleSoft properties/Secrets Manager.

QB customer record must pre-exist before invoice creation in UC1. Salesforce Account names may not match QB Customer names exactly. If no QB CustomerId stored on SF Account, UC1 flow must do a QB customer lookup by name — risk of false negatives on name mismatches (e.g. 'Austin ISD' vs 'Austin Independent School District').

systemFindings.finding: Connector confirmed in registry: mule4-google-sheets-connector 1.1, OAuth2 / Service Account. No playbook exists — stub created this session. Service Account approach preferred for server-to-server MuleSoft integration — eliminates user token rotation. Holly's spreadsheet must be shared with the Service Account email.
